payload.recallText: I began my illustrious career as a journalist at Fordham University at the Ram. Dean McGowan was annoying to me so at one point I smashed a pie in his face. I became known as Pie Man. There was a girl I liked and we had a beer together. I curse a lot and say things because I'm usually pissed off about something regarding the way things are run at Fordham with our Dean McGowan.
